blocks.text: MANDAUE CITY, Cebu — Persons in possession of firearms in Mandaue City could face under a proposed ordinance fines, community service and imprisonment if their negligence results in the access of minors to unsecured weapons. The proposed Safe Storage and Child Access Prevention or CAP Gun Ordinance of 2026, authored by City Councilor Carlo Pontico Fortuna, seeks to require all licensed firearm holders, including police officers, military personnel and private security guards, to secure their weapons and ammunition to prevent, barring children from accessing them.
